page.layout: One block of verse at the top under the running head; below it the word FINIS centred; below that a heading ORNA- at the right edge, cut off; then a woodcut ornament. No margin notes.

p.i: Soboles numero carens.Olympo non nitent Candente plura sydera,nec feruens suis plures arenas fluctibus Vomit mare. Non dicta,quidquid impietas satagat furens, Aut inquieta Daemonum cohors fremat, Mutare nostra quibit:ecce posteris Venturus est seclis Isacisanguine Rex cretus olim qui suos potentior Hostes triumphans Gentibus leges dabit, Et Vera cunctis iurà,quaeque Olympicos Ducant ad axes,explicabit orbitas.

page.notes: The verse is set in italic type; the page ends with an uncut woodcut ornament (a cornucopia-like frame with a face and foliage), not transcribed. The running head is taken from the top line. Original spelling retained, including the printed "Vera", "Vomit", "Isacisanguine" and the other forms as printed.
